description.ncbi_summary: Involved in negative regulation of protein localization to cell cortex and positive regulation of cell population proliferation. Located in several cellular components, including apical cortex; apical junction complex; and nuclear lumen. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Plays a role in planar mitotic spindle orientation in retinal progenitor cells (RPCs) and promotes the production of symmetric terminal divisions (By similarity). Negatively regulates the mitotic apical cortex localization of GPSM2 (PubMed:26766442). Involved also in positive regulation of cell proliferation and tumor cell growth (PubMed:23576022, PubMed:23704824).
